source: Open-Meteo ERA5 forecasts trained on GMT-day reanalysis; verified against NOAA SSODv2 station summaries
day_definition: 00:00–23:59 UTC for both sources; not the requested Asia/Tehran product day
issue_time_assumption: ERA5 values available through issue date minus 7 days; retrospective values may have been revised
station_limitations: SSOD mean uses 4–24 synoptic/hourly reports when available; reported min/max can miss true daily extremes. Station and ERA5 grid points differ.
